title: Layout
description: Fixed heading choices, roles and JSON pointers into one record type. It holds no values and no wording: labels come from roles or the record's own field names, headings from the fixed list or the repeated element's own code.

record_type.description: The record type given with the sample record, exactly. It is the source's name for this kind of record, which the record itself need not carry.

statuses.description: Status slots read beside the record's kind and date. The record's recognized statuses always read there, so these add only a status named in the record's own way.

sections.description: Headed groups of fields, in reading order.

fixed_heading.description: One of the fixed section headings.

oneOf.description: A fixed heading. In a repeated section it reads numbered from 1 for each element.
Only in a repeated section: each element reads under its own code's display or text, or else under this fixed heading numbered from 1.

repeat.description: A JSON pointer to an array in the record. The section repeats once per element, and each slot's pointer is relative to that element.

role.description: What part the value plays in the record. It also names the value: a result, unit, reference range or interpretation reads under its role's fixed label, and any other role under the record's own name for the field.

pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON pointer to one string, number or boolean in the record.
